shortDescription: This module allow to manage spaces of an Kibana installation

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The url used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: password
options.description: The password used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: spaces
options.description: This is a key value dictionary containing as key the id of the space and as value the specifications The allowed keys for the subdictionary are: I(color), I(description),  I(disabledFeatures), I(imageUrl), I(initials), I(name) and I(solution).

options.name: ssl_verify
options.description: Choose to verify the ssl certificate or not

options.name: user
options.description: The user used to connect with elasticsearch service
